newsitem.title: POLAND: Budimex, Costain build for Texaco in Poland.
newsitem.headline: Budimex, Costain build for Texaco in Poland.

text.p: A joint venture formed by Polish construction firm Budimex SA and Britain's Costain Co Ltd will build 150 to 200 petrol stations for Texaco Polska Sp z.o.o., Budimex spokeswoman said on Friday.
"Each station will cost about $1 million, and there will be about 150 to 200 of them," Irena Jagielska told Reuters.
"The venture, in which Budimex and Costain each have 50 percent, will identify sites, arrange all the formalities, build the stations and hand over the keys," Jagielska said.

She declined to reveal the total value of the deal and said the exact number of stations to be built for U.S. firm Texaco Inc's Polish subsidiary was not yet known because the Budimex-Costain venture had not chosen all the sites.
She also did not give a date for construction to start but said: "We want to do this as soon as possible".
